chat.description: Send a message to a model on the server and get its answer, with an optional system prompt, or a JSON schema to get the answer back as data.
chat.display_str_template: Send a message to the model '{0}'.
chat.name: chat

parameters.description: The model to answer, as the server names it, such as openai/gpt-oss-120b. Pick one the server lists, or type its name.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: What to ask or tell the model.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Instructions the model follows for the whole answer, such as its role or the format to answer in.
parameters.name: system

parameters.description: How varied the answer is, from 0 (the same answer every time) to 2. Leave empty for the server's own setting.
parameters.name: temperature

parameters.description: The most tokens the model may write, its thinking included (about three quarters of a word each). Leave empty to let the server decide.
parameters.name: max_tokens

parameters.description: A JSON schema the answer has to follow, pasted as JSON, such as {"type": "object", "properties": {"summary": {"type": "string"}}}. A later step then reads the answer's fields from json. Leave empty for an answer in plain text.
parameters.name: json_schema

finish_reason.description: Why the model stopped: stop when it finished, length when it reached the maximum tokens.

json.description: The answer read as JSON, usually a record with the fields the JSON schema names, when one was given; null without one.

model.description: The model that answered, as the server names it.

thinking.description: The model's reasoning before it answered, from a model that thinks first; null for one that doesn't.

usage.description: The tokens the request took, as the server counts them; 0 where it doesn't say.

input_tokens.description: Tokens in the prompt and the system prompt.

output_tokens.description: Tokens the model wrote, its thinking included.

list_models.description: List the models the server offers, with who owns each one.
list_models.display_str_template: List the models on the server.
list_models.name: list_models

models.description: The models, in the order the server lists them.

id.description: The model's id, as 'Send a message' takes it, such as openai/gpt-oss-120b.

owned_by.description: Who the server says owns the model, such as openai or vllm; empty when it doesn't say.

description: Chat with models on any server that takes OpenAI API requests at a Base URL you give, such as vLLM, LM Studio, NVIDIA NIM or an AI gateway, and list the models it serves.
